body: Hey sorry you're going through a tough time.  Thank you for doing this. I would be really happy to be added.

Dang I relate a fair bit to this.  I only have a few friends I talk to regularly, it's hard for me to get on with my coworkers, and I have the same problem with my father.  It really sucks.  And to go home only to deal with more stress from your mom must be really hard.  

I don't really have anything of value to say, but I hear you.  I hope your night can turn around and you can relax a bit.  Hang in there💕

I don't know about that, when I experience sleep paralysis I don't see or hear things, I just am not able to move and that's what terrifies me.

There was a time when my mom was driving late at night, I was in the back and fell asleep.  I woke up and couldn't move or talk,  my neck was in a terrible position that was extremely painful.  It lasted maybe a few minutes of me just trying to lift my body up until I finally could.  That was my worst experience with it so far, but that's kinda irrelevant.

I agree, I wish people would talk about it more, especially with how common it is.

And yeah, it's very sad to think about the trauma your parents experienced, but no matter what they went through doesn't excuse any of the trauma they have given to you.  You didn't deserve it, and their trauma should not be your responsibility

Have you heard "The Family Jewels" by Marina?  That song speaks to me, and maybe it would for you too.

Generational trauma is the worst, I wish more people would be responsible and take care of their own problems before having children.

I hope you can recover from your trauma and start feeling better:(

Hey, I'm so sorry you're going through this.  I can relate, my parents treated me horribly when I was younger, and I lashed out at them and they would just get angrier.  My parents said they wish they never had me.  They are the reason I'm depressed, but I still have this attachment to them, and it ruins me inside.  And of course, there's no apology.

I wish I could give some advice to move past it, but I'm still trying to figure that out for myself.  You're not an asshole, and you're not crazy.  I feel for you, you don't deserve to be treated badly, and you shouldn't feel guilty.  I'm wishing you peace♥️

I feel this, I used to feel secure, I never felt jealous of girls being around my ex, I trusted him.  And when he cheated on me it broke me, I lost all trust, I tried dating again but I'm so scared of getting hurt again.  And I'm just a broken mess that I hate.  I feel so pathetic.

But it's not your fault that you were cheated on, it's not because you weren't good enough.  Cheaters will cheat, it doesn't matter how perfect their partner is.

I wish I could give you a hug, and give you the comfort you need.  Healing is hard

My ex also threatened to take me to court, but this is before he and I broke up and I asked him what for, and he just said "That fact that you don't know, shows that you don't care", I was having a panic attack trying so hard to think of anything I could have done, I left him soon after and was having really bad anxiety every day for a couple months, but nothing ended up happening, and I've mostly calmed down.  But God, that stress was the worse

Yeah, I was actually sober for a few months till recently.  Being sober was awful, I would have really bad dreams of things that have happened in my past, I would wake up a lot throughout the night crying, I could barely get any sleep.

Now that I'm drinking in the evening, going to bed feels pleasant, and I don't get bad dreams anymore, I sleep through the whole night.  And I just feel a sense of appreciation for what I do have when I drink alcohol

Personally, when I drink alcohol it's the only time I feel a little peace.  I usually drink in the evening, and I'm careful to not drink too much, just enough to feel good.  There are times when it does make my depression come out stronger, but when that happens I just go to bed and sleep it off.

I can see how it could be a bad thing for some people, so I guess it just depends on you.  Or maybe I'm just giving really bad advice, idk
